name: Leslie in Paradise
source:
Leslie is an anthropomorphic husky who found herself in a new world called Paradise. 

Will she be able to conquer this wild place and become its goddess? Or will she be dominated by its inhabitants? Only you can decide her fate!

[From [url=https://dawnrn.itch.io/leslie-in-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莱斯利是一只拟人化的哈士奇，她发现自己身处一个名为天堂的新世界。

她能否征服这片荒野并成为这里的女神呢？或者她会被其居民所统治？只有你才能决定她的命运！

[来自[url=https://dawnrn.itch.io/leslie-in-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
